description: TACKLE COMMITMENT 5 - PRESS ENGAGEMENT. match::player::ActionPress vf5 0x144191160 refuses to engage unless dist^2 <= 42.25 (6.5 m). 56.25 (7.5 m) starts the closing-down a metre earlier, which is what feeds the tackle decide with in-range situations. This is the upstream lever: widening it without widening the tackle reach produces more pressure but no more challenges.
